Repeat the core position once on Ethereum so the same wallet shows activity on two of the protocol's chains, then hold every position for at least 30 days to span more than one snapshot. Cost: an extra $25 of capital and about $3 of gas on Ethereum. Time: 30 days across snapshots.

Bridge $50 of USDC into Bitcoin through tzBTC's own bridge interface, then supply the bridged funds once in the destination app so the receipt is used, not parked. Cost: $50 of capital and about $4 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Each week, bridge $10 back or forth through the protocol so more than one week shows bridge volume. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot, and never fully withdraw between weekly actions. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 30 days across snapshots.

Before you unwind, open the protocol's own points or rewards page from its official site, confirm your wallet's score, and claim only through the link it publishes. Cost: no fee to check, never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes to verify.
Log the wallet address, each transaction hash and the dates in a farm journal so you can repeat the position or unwind it after any token event. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes per entry.
